marta_dev: Heads up teamI have an engineer approved by director to move from Software Engineer II -> Senior Software Engineer, aiming for effective 2025-05-01. What exact paperwork and deadlines do I need to hit? @lina_hr

lina_hr: Congrats! Short checklist: 1) Submit Role Change packet in HR portal (choose 'title + salary'), 2) attach manager rationale (3 bullets), 3) attach director approval, 4) confirm budget code with finance, 5) route completes and People Ops will do band check and route to comp panel if needed.

diego_manager: Small note this is also a headcount-neutral reband (same FTE) but changes budget line. I already have finance approval in email. Do I attach that?

lina_hr: Yes attach the finance email. If budget code changes we need the cost center and new manager approver. Also tell us whether this is an internal only title change or part of a comp increase request.

michael_payroll: Payroll deadlines: to avoid backpay, we need final approved packet in payroll inbox by 2025-04-16 EOD for a 2025-05-01 effective date. If approved after that we will calculate retro to effective date. Submit earlier if you can.

marta_dev: Thanks. Also curious about comp panels  when are they required? This is a single band jump but still within same job family.

lina_hr: Comp panel usually triggers when a move crosses more than 1 band OR is an exceptional salary ask (above market cap for that band). For single-band level moves People Ops typically approves after manager + director signoff. We will flag if panel is needed.

diego_manager: If we want to include a one-time retention payment in addition to base bump, how do we coordinate that?

lina_hr: Separate flow: file Compensation Adjustment for one-time payments and link it to the Role Change packet in notes. Finance signoff needed for one-time payments. Payroll likes one combined packet so they can process both together; include clear payroll comment: "One-time X in pay period YYYY-MM, base change effective 2025-05-01."

michael_payroll: If you include both, add the employee ID and preferred pay period for the one-time in the payroll comments. That avoids duplication.

marta_dev: Great. I'll submit the portal form tonight and attach director + finance emails. Will ping here when done. :slightly_smiling_face: 

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Required fields for Role Change packet: employee name, employee ID, current title, new title, proposed base, effective date, manager rationale, director approval, budget code. Attach PDFs or links. HR portal: https://hr.redwood.internal/role-change. Payroll deadlines: https://payroll.redwood.internal/deadlines.
